title: Howard Marks: CNBC The Exchange (2026)
description:
In this interview with Kelly Evans on CNBC The Exchange, Howard Marks, Co-Chair of Oaktree, shares his perspective on market volatility, the uncertainty surrounding AI, and why disciplined investors should focus on risk-adjusted opportunities rather than market sentiment. He discusses AI infrastructure, private credit, interest rates, and the importance of human judgment in an increasingly AI-driven world. (Recorded on October 30, 2026)
